speaker: Doctor

Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned fatigue, flank pain, and fever after recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis; have you noticed any changes in your urine color or frequency?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Leukocyturia Present, Bacterial_Culture Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel's_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm. Renal_Ultrasound: NORMAL READINGS.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the presence of eosinophiluria and normal ultrasound findings, does the flank pain radiate to your groin, and do you have a history of allergies or asthma?

text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.
